1-1.text: Part one. Factors. ... A factor of a number divides into it exactly, with nothing left over. Let's arrange 12 counters into rectangles.

1-2.text: 12 makes 1 row of 12, 2 rows of 6 and 3 rows of 4. So the factors come in pairs: 1 and 12, 2 and 6, 3 and 4.

1-4.text: The highest common factor (HCF) is the biggest factor that two numbers share. The HCF of 24 and 36 is 12.

2-1.text: Part two. Multiples. ... The multiples of a number are the answers in its times table. The multiples of 4 are 4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24 and so on.

2-2.text: The lowest common multiple (LCM) is the smallest number in both lists. The multiples of 6 are 6, 12, 18, 24… so the LCM of 4 and 6 is 12.

2-3.text: One bus comes every 12 minutes and another every 18 minutes. They both leave at 9:00. The LCM of 12 and 18 is 36, so they next leave together 36 minutes later.

3-1.text: Part three. Prime numbers. ... A prime number has exactly two factors: 1 and itself. 7 is prime: the only way to make it is 1 times 7.

3-2.text: 9 is not prime: it has three factors, 1, 3 and 9. And 1 is not prime either, because it has only one factor.

3-3.text: Here are the primes up to 30: 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, 19, 23 and 29. 2 is the only even prime.

4-1.text: Part four. Prime factor trees. ... Every whole number bigger than 1 is either prime or can be made by multiplying primes. A factor tree finds them. Start by splitting 60 into 6 times 10.

4-2.text: Keep splitting until every branch ends in a prime: 6 equals 2 times 3, and 10 equals 2 times 5. Ring the primes.

4-3.text: So 60 equals 2 times 2 times 3 times 5. With a power, that is 2 squared, times 3, times 5.

5-1.text: Part five. Powers and roots. ... A square number is a number times itself. 4 squared means 4 times 4, which equals 16: a square that is 4 by 4.

5-2.text: A cube number multiplies three times: 4 cubed equals 4 times 4 times 4, which equals 64.

5-3.text: Roots go backwards. The square root of 81 is 9, because 9 times 9 equals 81. And the cube root of 125 is 5, because 5 times 5 times 5 equals 125.

5-4.text: The square numbers to learn: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, 100, 121 and 144.
